Methodology

How the ledger is kept.

  1. Prices come only from each vendor’s own pricing page. Each row stores the source URL and check date.
  2. A row is verified when the figure was read on that date. We never estimate a missing price.
  3. Estimated monthly cost = base + user overage (MAU/MRU bands) + SSO connection fees from the published ladder + published B2B organization fees (see below). Logto token overage is noted but not assumed from MAU.
  4. SSO users per connection (assumption). Amazon Cognito, Supabase Auth and Firebase Auth / Identity Platform bill SAML/OIDC per SSO user, not per connection (first 50 free, then $0.015 per SSO user a month). To compare them with per-connection vendors we assume 200 SSO users per connection by default; you can change it in the calculator. We also count those users inside your total MAU, which can slightly overstate these vendors above their free direct-user allowance; we keep the higher figure. Sensitivity, computed from the same ledger rows (cheapest plan, monthly, rank among all priceable plans):

  5. B2B organizations / tenants. Vendors price customer organizations differently, so the calculator takes an organization count (default 0 = B2C). Every SSO connection counts as at least one customer organization (we assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection), with as many members as its SSO users (200 by default, capped at users ÷ orgs). We add published org fees to the total and leave out plans over a published org cap. Yes for Clerk, Auth0, Descope, Kinde and Logto. At 10k users with 1 SSO customer (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection, 200 members), Clerk Pro is $125/mo because more than 20 members per org needs the B2B Authentication add-on ($100/mo); with 20 or fewer members it is $25/mo. Auth0 Free lists $0 but caps at 5 organizations. At 10k users and 150 organizations (no SSO): Clerk Pro $175/mo (incl. $150 org fees), Descope Pro $364/mo (incl. $115), Kinde Pro $75/mo (incl. $50); Auth0 Free and B2C plans are out (5 and 10-org caps). Correction 2026-10-31: before that date SSO answers ignored org fees, so for example Clerk vs Auth0 at 10k users · 1 SSO read “$300/yr less than Clerk” instead of $1,500/yr.

Cognito, Firebase / Identity Platform and Supabase Auth publish no per-organization fee, so orgs add $0 there.

  6. SCIM / Directory Sync. The calculator takes the number of SSO customers that also need SCIM (default 0; we assumes every SCIM customer is also an SSO customer, so it is capped at the SSO connection count). We add each vendor’s published SCIM fee: a separate connection ladder (WorkOS; Clerk, billed from 2027-01-01), a pool shared with SSO connections (Stytch), or included (Auth0 inbound SCIM on Free and B2B plans, Descope Growth). Plans with no published SCIM price, SCIM “coming soon”, or SCIM only on another plan drop out of SCIM scenarios rather than show an invented figure. At 10k users · 3 SSO + 3 SCIM customers (assumes every SCIM customer is also an SSO customer; assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection), cheapest verified plan per vendor: Stytch Pay as you go (B2B) $125/mo incl. $125/mo SCIM; Scalekit Growth $339/mo incl. $120/mo SCIM; Clerk Pro $425/mo incl. $150/mo SCIM (Directory Sync billed from 2027-01-01, $0 before) and $100/mo B2B Authentication add-on; SSOJet Business $432/mo incl. $195/mo SCIM; WorkOS AuthKit $750/mo incl. $375/mo SCIM; Descope Growth $799/mo incl. $0/mo SCIM; Auth0 Essentials (B2B) $2,100/mo incl. $0/mo SCIM. WorkOS bills SSO and Directory Sync as separate connections, so a customer on both is two connections; Stytch’s 5 included connections are shared between SSO and SCIM; Scalekit bills SCIM as a separate connection (first of each free); SSOJet bills SSO and SCIM on one shared connection ladder. Not priceable with SCIM: Amazon Cognito (no SCIM on the pricing page), Logto (no SCIM on the pricing page), Kinde (SCIM coming soon), Supabase Auth (no SCIM on the pricing page), Firebase Auth / Identity Platform (no SCIM on the pricing page). Addition 2026-10-31: before that date SCIM was listed per plan but never added to totals, so WorkOS at 3 SSO + SCIM customers read $375/mo instead of $750/mo.

  7. Headline number. At 100k users, Clerk Pro lists $1,025/mo; WorkOS AuthKit, the cheapest verified plan that includes MFA at that size, lists $0 ($12,300/yr less). We compare a named, popular plan with the cheapest verified plan that includes MFA at the same user count (no SSO), because that is a saving a team can actually capture. The max-minus-min spread across all 15 plans priced at 50k users · 5 SSO is $26,817/yr (Descope Pro vs Firebase Auth / Identity Platform Pay as you go, the latter assumes 200 SSO users per connection); we keep it here only, since nobody chooses between those two.
  8. Ties and precision. Plans at the same price are shown as ties (for example “tie at $0”), never as wins or ordinal ranks. Rates show the precision the vendor publishes (for example Supabase $0.00325 per MAU).
  9. Auth0 sells paid plans in published MAU tiers (B2C to 50k, B2B to 20k, from auth0.com/pricing.md); usage between tiers is priced at the next tier up, as Auth0 bills it. Above the top tier only Enterprise (contact sales) remains, so we omit Auth0 there rather than invent a number. Correction 2026-10-31: before that date we wrongly treated tiers above 500 MAU as custom.
  10. Stytch MAU overage rate was not printed as a fixed USD figure on the checked page — left blank.
  11. Every vendor pricing page was last read on 2026-10-31–2026-11-07 (12 of 12); the date sits on every ledger row. Checks run by hand (our check script plus a read of the page), not on a fixed automatic schedule yet, and so far the ledger has been re-read on 2026-10-30 and 2026-10-31. Pro alerts go out by hand after we confirm a change, so they arrive after our next check, not in real time.
